title: Source files must be pure ASCII -- no box-drawing / bullet / smart-quote (repo series)
desc: Repo-management series entry: .ps1 (and other source) must be PURE ASCII -- the pre-commit gate hard-blocks non-ASCII bytes. Decorative unicode in COMMENTS (box-drawing, bullets, em-dash, smart quotes) is the silent culprit. Hit twice 2026-06-18.
steps: RULE: source files (.ps1/.psm1/.cs/.py...) must be PURE ASCII -- the pre-commit gate ('non-ASCII bytes in <f> (.ps1 must be pure ASCII)') HARD-BLOCKS the commit otherwise. Korean prose belongs in .md/docs only (the harness:block Korean-in-source rule); but the SNEAKY failure is DECORATIVE UNICODE in English comments.

THE SILENT CULPRITS (caught 2026-06-18, TWICE in one session): a bullet 'U+25CF' written in a comment like "the bullet Bash(...) MD pattern", and box-drawing 'U+2500' in a decorative self-test header like '# ---- SELF-TEST ----'. Also watch: em-dash U+2014, smart quotes U+2018/2019/201C/201D, non-breaking space U+00A0, ellipsis U+2026, arrows. Agent-generated protos LOVE to insert these in headers/comments.

DETECT before commit: grep -nP '[^\x00-\x7F]' <file>  (lists the exact offending lines). FIX: replace with ASCII -- bullet -> '-' or 'o' or the word 'bullet'; box-drawing -> '-' or '='; em-dash -> '--'; smart quotes -> straight ' ". Re-grep to confirm zero.

WHEN MERGING AGENT PROTOS: agents (esp. sonnet/haiku) decorate comment headers with unicode. ALWAYS grep -P '[^\x00-\x7F]' an agent-built .ps1 BEFORE git add -- the pre-commit will block you otherwise and you will re-debug it. This belongs in the agent-proto merge checklist. Cluster: [[repo-management-skill-series]], [[repo-garbage-collector-unused-file-quarantine]].
